<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–150 ppm) are at 130.70, 130.27, 128.35, 126.66, 124.85, and 123.57 ppm – six distinct signals. These correspond to aromatic carbons. Therefore, the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
